# Contributing

**This project is not accepting unsolicited contributions.**

It is a personal project with a single author. Pull requests may be closed without
review — please don't spend your time on one that wasn't invited.

**Found a bug?** If you are one of the league's testers, report it directly to the
author (not here): note the version shown on the app's **Help** page, describe what you
did and what happened, and attach the newest file from the `logs/` folder — the Help
page has an **Open logs folder** button.

**Want to use the code?** See [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE). The source is published to be
read, not reused; permission for anything in section 2 can be granted individually, so
just ask.
